name: Inani Securities Limited
about: Inani Securities Limited engages in stock broking and financial services to individual and institutional clients in India. The company offers equities, futures and options, currencies, financial planning, institutional equities, depository services, mutual funds, IPO, investment advisory services, and loan against shares. It also provides online net trading through BEST. Inani Securities Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.
